description: This file defines models and a fetcher class for retrieving and processing historical currency data from the Tiingo API, including query parameter handling, data transformation, and data fetching logic.

classes.name: TiingoCurrencyHistoricalQueryParams
classes.description: Model for Tiingo currency historical price query parameters, including custom aliasing and schema details.

classes.name: TiingoCurrencyHistoricalData
classes.description: Model representing the historical price data fetched from Tiingo.

classes.name: TiingoCurrencyHistoricalFetcher
classes.description: Fetcher class that transforms query parameters, retrieves data asynchronously from Tiingo API, and transforms raw data into models.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Transforms input parameters by setting default start and end dates if missing.

methods.name: aextract_data
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches raw data from Tiingo API for given symbols, handling errors and warnings.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Transforms raw data into sorted list of TiingoCurrencyHistoricalData models.
